original_record.name: Latch
original_record.spec: Subject: Latch, the lanky sickly male zombie in the supplied scan. Slouched body, head tilted sideways, short dark hair with a raised front tuft, pallid gray-green face. Ragged open green-and-black mottled/plaid long jacket over a dirty torn pale shirt with a small muted red stain on the chest, worn medium-blue jeans torn and shortened unevenly at the shins, exposed discolored ankles, dark red-brown shoes. Both arms hang down with open hands. Unarmed. Match the scan's lankiness and green jacket, do not dress him in a generic suit.

original_record.name: Bat Zombie
original_record.spec: Subject: the bat zombie in the supplied scan, a flying severed-looking humanoid male HEAD with two black membranous bat wings extending from either side and small thin yellow-green clawed appendages hanging below the jaw.
